evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Agent harnesses enable large language models to act through tools, observe the results, and iteratively work toward a task goal.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: Independent review by a critic offers a more favorable accuracy-cost tradeoff, improving average accuracy by 5.9-9.5 percentage points on TB and 3.9-6.6 on SWE at 1.13-1.25 and 1.00-1.04 times baseline cost, respectively.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: We compare 17 designs across seven frontier coding models on Terminal-Bench (TB) and SWE-bench Verified (SWE), and introduce VisualBench for expert evaluation of visual and interactive artifacts.
